measurement.purpose: Distinguish a direct RA0/V031-to-receiver-TP6/V072 continuation from two separate nets.
measurement.raw_user_statement:
PetSafe E06: one hidden receiver-to-PIC connection / v0.9.37
B59 red A0 / black T6 (Unpowered): 1.5 ohm
measurement.conditions: Unpowered reported. Battery/programmer disconnection requested. No fresh probe baseline or stability report supplied.

assessment: B59 1.5 ohm supports direct continuity from PIC RA0/C25 to TP6. Prior local traces place R27.1 and C18.2 on TP6; prior via associations place V031 and V072 on the combined node. Those local branches and individual vias were not remeasured in B59.
boundaries: R27 separates this node from U3.1 / RX_A_OUT.
limit: A low in-circuit reading supports net membership, not exact copper resistance, ADC/firmware configuration or complete receiver behavior. TP11/TP17 onward paths remain qualified.
